healthcheck.name: real friction + clean workflow artifacts and claude CLI present
healthcheck.command: MAIN="$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)")" && W="$MAIN/.craftflow/state/workflows" && for id in wf-adr-0044-audit-only-opt-pre-20260927-130317-27b13b3e wf-jev-client-remove-craftflow-jev-20261001-211114-31b6d506; do test -f "$W/$id.json" && test -f "$W/$id.events.jsonl" || exit 1; done && command -v claude
healthcheck.expected: exit 0; both workflow artifact+events pairs exist in the main tree and claude is on PATH

scenarios.name: LV-R1 Friction workflow is cited
scenarios.given: the real wf-adr-0044 artifact and events log in the main tree
scenarios.when: craftflow_retro.py --wf wf-adr-0044-... runs against the main-tree state dir
scenarios.then: exit 0; friction_found true; signal ids include remfix_cycles (count >= 9), circuit_breaker_tripped, loop_counts, compactions; first remfix_cycles evidence key is remediation_history[0]
scenarios.command: MAIN="$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)")" && python3 plugins/craftflow/scripts/craftflow_retro.py --state-dir "$MAIN/.craftflow/state" --wf wf-adr-0044-audit-only-opt-pre-20260927-130317-27b13b3e | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); s={x["id"]:x for x in d["signals"]}; need=("remfix_cycles","circuit_breaker_tripped","loop_counts","compactions"); miss=[i for i in need if i not in s]; assert d["friction_found"] is True, "friction_found not true"; assert not miss, "missing signals: %s" % miss; assert s["remfix_cycles"]["count"] >= 9, "remfix count %s" % s["remfix_cycles"]["count"]; k=s["remfix_cycles"]["evidence"][0]["key"]; assert k == "remediation_history[0]", "first evidence key %s" % k; print("lv_r1 friction_found=true remfix_count=%s first_key=%s ids=%s" % (s["remfix_cycles"]["count"], k, sorted(s)))'

scenarios.name: LV-R2 Clean workflow reports no friction
scenarios.given: the real wf-jev-client-remove artifact and events log
scenarios.when: the same command runs with that id
scenarios.command: MAIN="$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)")" && python3 plugins/craftflow/scripts/craftflow_retro.py --state-dir "$MAIN/.craftflow/state" --wf wf-jev-client-remove-craftflow-jev-20261001-211114-31b6d506 | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d["friction_found"] is False and d["signals"] == [], "unexpected signals: %s" % [x["id"] for x in d["signals"]]; print("lv_r2 friction_found=false signals=[]")'

scenarios.name: LV-R3 Read-only on real state
scenarios.given: sha256 of both workflows' artifact+events files and git status --porcelain of the main tree captured
scenarios.when: the LV-R1 and LV-R2 commands run
scenarios.then: both hashes and the porcelain output are identical afterwards
scenarios.command: MAIN="$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)")" && W="$MAIN/.craftflow/state/workflows" && F="$W/wf-adr-0044-audit-only-opt-pre-20260927-130317-27b13b3e.json $W/wf-adr-0044-audit-only-opt-pre-20260927-130317-27b13b3e.events.jsonl $W/wf-jev-client-remove-craftflow-jev-20261001-211114-31b6d506.json $W/wf-jev-client-remove-craftflow-jev-20261001-211114-31b6d506.events.jsonl" && H0=$(shasum -a 256 $=F) && G0=$(git -C "$MAIN" status --porcelain) && python3 plugins/craftflow/scripts/craftflow_retro.py --state-dir "$MAIN/.craftflow/state" --wf wf-adr-0044-audit-only-opt-pre-20260927-130317-27b13b3e >/dev/null && python3 plugins/craftflow/scripts/craftflow_retro.py --state-dir "$MAIN/.craftflow/state" --wf wf-jev-client-remove-craftflow-jev-20261001-211114-31b6d506 >/dev/null && H1=$(shasum -a 256 $=F) && G1=$(git -C "$MAIN" status --porcelain); echo "same_hash=$([ "$H0" = "$H1" ] && echo 1 || echo 0) same_git=$([ "$G0" = "$G1" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)"; [ "$H0" = "$H1" ] && [ "$G0" = "$G1" ]

scenarios.name: LV-R4 Cursor install links cursor-router, retro, status, failure-digest (scratch HOME)
scenarios.given: a scratch dir that is HOME, the Cursor home and the cwd, with raw.githubusercontent.com reachable
scenarios.when: install-cursor.sh runs from the plugin under test with stdin closed
scenarios.then: exit 0; installer_rc=0 links_ok=1 (cursor-router, retro, status and failure-digest are symlinks resolving to the plugin under test); scratch removed. Offline: prints 'connection refused: ...' so the runner reports BLOCKED, not FAIL
scenarios.command: if ! curl -fsSI --max-time 10 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aicraft-sdk/craftflow/main/plugins/craftflow/rules/craftflow-router.mdc >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "connection refused: raw.githubusercontent.com unreachable (offline); LV-R4 needs network"; exit 1; fi; SCR=$(mktemp -d); INSTALLER="$PWD/plugins/craftflow/install-cursor.sh"; PR="$PWD/plugins/craftflow/skills"; (cd "$SCR" && HOME="$SCR" CURSOR_HOME="$SCR/.cursor" CURSOR_SKILLS_DIR="$SCR/.cursor/skills" bash "$INSTALLER" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1); RC=$?; OK=1; for n in cursor-router retro status failure-digest; do { test -L "$SCR/.cursor/skills/$n" && test "$(cd "$SCR/.cursor/skills/$n" && pwd -P)" = "$(cd "$PR/$n" && pwd -P)"; } || OK=0; done; rm -rf "$SCR"; echo "installer_rc=$RC links_ok=$OK"; test "$RC" = 0 && test "$OK" = 1

scenarios.name: LV-R6 Claude Code end-to-end
scenarios.given: the plugin under test via absolute --plugin-dir, a scratch project holding byte copies of the real wf-adr-0044 artifact and events, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID unset, CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR = scratch project
scenarios.when: claude -p --model haiku is asked to use the craftflow:retro skill on that workflow
scenarios.then: exit 0; rc=0 header>=1 cited>=1 router_outside_handoff=0 wf_artifacts=1 same_hash=1 same_git=1
scenarios.command: MAIN="$(dirname "$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)")"; PLUGIN="$PWD/plugins/craftflow"; ID=wf-adr-0044-audit-only-opt-pre-20260927-130317-27b13b3e; SCR=$(mktemp -d); W="$SCR/p/.craftflow/state/workflows"; mkdir -p "$W" && cp "$MAIN/.craftflow/state/workflows/$ID.json" "$MAIN/.craftflow/state/workflows/$ID.events.jsonl" "$W/" || exit 1; H0=$(cat "$W/$ID.json" "$W/$ID.events.jsonl" | shasum -a 256); G0=$(git -C "$MAIN" status --porcelain); printf '%s' "Use the craftflow:retro skill on workflow $ID" | (cd "$SCR/p" && env -u CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT -u CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID -u TYPESAFE_API_KEY CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$SCR/p" claude -p --plugin-dir "$PLUGIN" --model haiku --allowedTools Skill "Bash(python3:*)" Read Glob) > "$SCR/out" 2>&1; RC=$?; H1=$(cat "$W/$ID.json" "$W/$ID.events.jsonl" | shasum -a 256); G1=$(git -C "$MAIN" status --porcelain); HDR=$(grep -c 'Retro: wf-adr-0044' "$SCR/out"); CITE=$(grep -Ec 'remediation_history\[|events:L' "$SCR/out"); ROUTER=$(grep 'craftflow-router' "$SCR/out" | grep -v 'NOT go through craftflow-router' | grep -v 'skills/craftflow-router/' | grep -vc 'To act on a proposal'); WF=$(ls "$W" | grep -c '^wf-.*\.json$'); rm -rf "$SCR"; echo "rc=$RC header=$HDR cited=$CITE router_outside_handoff=$ROUTER wf_artifacts=$WF same_hash=$([ "$H0" = "$H1" ] && echo 1 || echo 0) same_git=$([ "$G0" = "$G1" ] && echo 1 || echo 0)"; test "$RC" = 0 && test "$HDR" -ge 1 && test "$CITE" -ge 1 && test "$ROUTER" = 0 && test "$WF" = 1 && [ "$H0" = "$H1" ] && [ "$G0" = "$G1" ]
scenarios.expected: exit 0; rc=0 header>=1 cited>=1 router_outside_handoff=0 wf_artifacts=1 same_hash=1 same_git=1
